svg.title: Zoya Fatima: Towards machines that imagine, and knowing why they do
svg.desc: Title page of a research-paper style profile for Zoya Fatima. Keywords: generative models · diffusion · transformers · research methods. Figure 0 animates random noise resolving into a flower-shaped curve, like a diffusion model denoising.
